summary: Changes point sharing between primitives. It can create unique points per vertex, cusp polygon edges by angle, consolidate nearby points, remove degenerate primitives, remove unused points, and compute point normals.

key_params.name: operation
key_params.note: No operation, unique points, cusp polygons, or consolidate points

key_params.name: angle
key_params.note: Cusp angle threshold between adjacent faces

key_params.name: removedegenerate
key_params.note: Remove primitives with repeated consecutive vertices

key_params.name: removeunusedpoints
key_params.note: Remove points no longer referenced by primitives

key_params.name: gridres
key_params.note: Voxel grid resolution for spatial-grid-per-voxel consolidation

key_params.name: specifybbox
key_params.note: Specify a bounding box for spatial-grid consolidation

key_params.name: bbox
key_params.note: SOP used as the consolidation bounding box

key_params.name: cpureadback
key_params.note: Copy topology information back to the CPU

key_concepts: Facet POP changes point sharing by making unique points, cusping polygon edges, consolidating nearby points, or leaving topology untouched.
Cusp and consolidate operations are threshold driven: angle controls shared-edge separation, while distance and technique control point merging.
Cleanup options can remove degenerate primitives and unused points, and optional normal computation refreshes shading after topology sharing changes.
common_gotchas: Unique Points changes point counts and breaks shared-point assumptions downstream.
Consolidate Points can alter point indices; avoid it before index arrays, groups, or neighbor caches that depend on old indices.
Run Normal POP or enable normal computation after topology-sharing changes when shading needs updated normals.
